title: sempervivum pruinatum
intro: Sempervivum pruinatum, commonly known as the Frosty Hens and Chicks, is a succulent plant species in the family Crassulaceae. It is known for its rosettes of silvery-gray leaves, which provide a unique ornamental value to gardens. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation and skin conditions, due to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Sempervivum pruinatum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its potential health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
